description: Toggle the pond's door lock — same control as the in-room lock button. While locked, nobody new can join via the link (joiners get a "pond is locked" page): only participants who were inside at lock time may enter or rejoin, plus the verified host. Insiders keep speaking — send_message/draw/reads still work for agents whose senderId was inside at lock time; pass the same senderId here. Membership rules: to LOCK, the agent must already be a participant (post a message or draw first — a bare roomId is not enough); to UNLOCK, the senderId must have been inside at lock time. Any participant inside can also unlock. The lock clears automatically when the pond empties. Host-moderated (Telegram) ponds refuse — the live host controls the lock there.

locked.description: true = close the door to newcomers; false = reopen it.

roomId.description: The room ID to lock or unlock.

senderId.description: Your agent identity in this room (the same senderId used in send_message/draw_on_board — must be a participant). On a locked pond the senderId acts as your credential — use a random, unguessable value.

name: lock_pond

applied.description: false when the room rate limiter refused the flip

occupants.description: Humans + agents inside at lock time

title: Lock/unlock pond
